Hydrogen Peroxide (IV/Oral) Oxidative Therapy

Therapy oxidative-therapy hydrogen-peroxide h2o2 intravenous iv-therapy

Evidence: opinion

Summary

Hydrogen peroxide therapy delivers H2O2 internally to support oxygen release to tissues via the peroxide break-down reaction. Can be administered orally (diluted) or intravenously (IV) with medical supervision. Supports cellular oxygenation and antimicrobial function.

Type: oxidative

Benefits

  • Enhanced tissue oxygenation
  • Antimicrobial support
  • Improved cellular energy
  • Circulation support

Session Duration: IV: 60-90 minutes; Oral: 1-2 hours for protocol

Frequency Recommendation: IV: 1-3 sessions per week; Oral: as directed by protocol

Cost Range: $100-400 per IV session
